_comment: Persistent exclusion list for the published catalogue. This is a women's modest-fashion directory, so men's items and non-apparel (fragrance, gift sets, etc.) are dropped at build time and can never be reintroduced by a rebuild. Add to this file to kill something permanently, then run `npm run build:data`.
_nonApparelAllowIds: Escape hatch: product ids the non-apparel veto wrongly rejects. Reviewed keeps.
_brandNonApparelExpected: Brands legitimately >25% accessories, verified by hand. Stops Guard 3 in build-data.mjs from failing the build on them.
